about_item: Halloween Window Clings：one set contains 10 sheets Halloween themed window stickers, measures 11x8.7 in each sheet, 146pcs decals in total.
Material: this holiday window clings are made with premium PVC with vibrant color paintings, double-sided design, water resistant, easy to stick on and peel off with no residue left.

Cute Design: this set of window gel decals stickers are specially designed for Halloween party decoration with bats, wolf, devil trees, pumpkins, witch, zombies, ghost and other Halloween elements, looks festive and lovely.

Use Instruction: these window gel stickers can easily stick on smooth surface,like glass, just clean the target surface with wet towels and then peel off the stickers from the sheet, stick on the wet clean smooth surface, press a while and then it will hold tightly.

Wide Application: this set of window clings decal stickers are perfect for Halloween home decorations, which can be put on glass windows, doors, refrigerators and more, make your Halloween a big event!
